note.headline: A productive week on Joe's Aim 2 analyses, Prospector and Root Canal, with clean recording lists and active avoidance run on three mice.
note.summary: Most effort went into finishing Joe's Aim 2 analyses with statistics and checks for every figure, and into Root Canal workflows that separate dentate spikes from P-spikes. Prospector, a new model for Panning's pools, now sorts events without overriding anyone's decision. In tested pools it called 51% of real spikes correctly, and 0.7% of its spike calls were garbage. Recording lists were cleaned of empty stub folders. At the bench, active avoidance ran on three mice over two days. No new recordings arrived.
progress: Joe's figures now carry stars, a statistics PDF each, fitted axes and a sanity-check report, and a new tab covers all 23 requests of his final run sheet.
Prospector sorts Panning's pools into spike, likely spike and likely garbage, never overriding a person's decision.
Root Canal workflows define a border from known examples, apply it, and bank the result, with every point traceable to its recording; a fourth workflow combines pools.
Empty stub folders were removed from the recording lists and can no longer be added, and five wrongly retired recordings are back.
The app now says P-spike instead of IED, with dentate spikes in blue and P-spikes in red.
X-ray can process many recordings at once, and Jarvis has a steadier connection, an easier setup on new computers and a weekly emailed printout.
bench: Active avoidance ran on mice 1652, 1658 and 1663 on 6 November, led by Angelina, Daphne, Avery and Samara.
A second active avoidance session ran on the same three mice on 7 November, led by Angelina.
The colony stands at 80 alive: 76 stock and 4 mating.
data: The Event Bank holds 20 entries and 17,655 events: 8,191 dentate spikes, 7,869 pooled and 1,595 P-spikes.
Prospector made 16,587 calls, and people made 104.
No new recordings arrived this week.
next: People will settle Prospector's flags in Panning.
Four older checks that fail on wording will be brought up to date.
Work on the remaining Aim 2 items continues.
The first emailed weekly printout goes out on Friday at 3 PM.
watch: Four older checks still fail on wording and display details unrelated to this week's work; they are tracked and the daily error review is catching new faults.
53 code files are changed but not yet committed and need committing so every machine matches.
Prospector is deliberately cautious, so about half of the real spikes still need a person to decide.
The empty stub folders remain on netfiles for the lab to delete.
